text:
Maria (PM): Quick sync — proposing a canary bench + cost-sharing approach for pinned model migrations. Need alignment on canary metrics, customer notice window, and rollback thresholds. TL;DR: run 2-week canary on 5% traffic, bench for throughput/cost/quality, offer migration credits to affected customers. Thoughts? @Josh @Sam @Olivia

Josh (Eng): +1 on canary. A couple clarifications: is this hosted-only or do we include Dedicated/Private? For hosted we can route 5% easily, but we need to ensure KV cache seeding and warmup. Perf bench needs stable seq-length distribution; otherwise throughput numbers will be noisy.

Sam (ML): For quality metrics I propose: a prompt-suite pass metric + embedding-similarity checks + a latency-aware proxy for perplexity. Sample size: 10k prompts pulled from production distributions, stratified by tenant and use-case. Also include a small adversarial set to catch regressions.

Olivia (CS): From CS/comm perspective: customers want clarity. Recommend a 30-day notice for deprecation + a migration window. Migration credits idea: 2 months Dedicated credits for top 10 customers, smaller credits for self-serve customers. Legal needs to sign off on any contract/credits language.

Maria (PM): Proposed decision criteria (draft):
- Quality: if top-line metric drops >3% vs baseline or customer-facing error increases -> pause.
- Cost: if per-token cost delta >20% -> auto-trigger alternate rollout path.
- Rollback: auto-fallback to previous pinned model for >95% of requests within 60s when triggered.
Agree/disagree?

Josh (Eng): Auto-fallback is doable. Implementation notes: we need per-tenant routing policy + rollout-config baked into the catalog service. Example rollout JSON we can use as a starting point:

```json
{
  "rollout_pct": 5,
  "fallback_model": "catalog/v1.2",
  "max_cost_delta_pct": 20
}
```

Sam (ML): Add embedding-drift gating too: if mean cosine similarity to baseline vectors drops <0.85 -> fail. We'll run nightly evals during the canary and surface deltas in the dashboard.

Olivia (CS): Timing note: don't send customer notice until canary clears week-1 smoke tests. Some enterprise customers prefer an opt-out window instead of forced cutover; we should support that as a special-case.

DeployBot: Canary route created — env=prod region=us-west begin=1712000001 id=canary-1723 :white_check_mark:

Maria (PM): Action items:
- Josh: prototype rollout-config + fallback in staging by EOD Wed
- Sam: curate 10k prompt sample + baseline eval by Mon
- Olivia: draft customer comms and credits proposal by Fri
Sync Friday 11am to review metrics. :calendar:

Josh (Eng): Ack. One question: cache seeding strategy? I propose a backfill job that replays top prefixes into the KV cache before ramping traffic, with rate limits so we don't spike infra. I'll add a short runbook.

Sam (ML): I'll add a synthetic stress set for hallucination/regression checks and recommend human spot-checks for the top 20 tenants.

Olivia (CS): I'll try to line up a pilot customer for the early migration (ACME corp expressed interest last month). Good proof point for comms and credits.

Maria (PM): Great — if no objections I'll schedule the Friday sync and lock the canary plan. Thanks all :tada:
